ham_wasl.name: Hamzat al-wasl
ham_wasl.what: A connecting hamza at the start of a word.
ham_wasl.how: Say it only when you begin reciting from this word. When you continue from the word before, skip it and join the sounds.

laam_shamsiyah.name: Lam shamsiyah (sun letter)
laam_shamsiyah.what: The lam of “al-” before a sun letter.
laam_shamsiyah.how: Do not pronounce the lam. Say the letter after it with a shaddah, as if it were doubled.

silent.name: Silent letter
silent.what: A letter that is written but not pronounced.
silent.how: Skip it when you read. It stays silent whether you stop or continue.

madda_normal.name: Madd tabi'i (natural)
madda_normal.what: A vowel that is naturally long: alif after a fathah, waw after a dammah, ya after a kasrah.
madda_normal.how: Hold the sound for 2 counts: no more, no less.

madda_permissible.name: Madd ja'iz (permissible)
madda_permissible.what: A lengthening that may be held for 2, 4 or 6 counts. It is common when you stop at the end of an ayah.
madda_permissible.how: Pick one length and keep it the same through your recitation.

madda_obligatory.name: Madd wajib muttasil (obligatory, joined)
madda_obligatory.what: A madd letter followed by a hamza in the same word.
madda_obligatory.how: Hold the sound for 4 to 5 counts.

madda_necessary.name: Madd lazim (necessary)
madda_necessary.what: A madd letter followed by a letter with a sukun or shaddah in the same word.

qalaqah.name: Qalqalah (echo)
qalaqah.what: The letters ق ط ب ج د with a sukun, or when you stop on them.
qalaqah.how: Give the letter a light bounce or echo, without adding a vowel.

ikhafa.name: Ikhfa (hiding)
ikhafa.what: A nun sakinah or tanwin before one of 15 letters.
ikhafa.how: Hide the nun: say it with a nasal sound for about 2 counts while your tongue moves toward the next letter.

ikhafa_shafawi.name: Ikhfa shafawi (lip hiding)
ikhafa_shafawi.what: A mim sakinah before the letter ب.
ikhafa_shafawi.how: Hide the mim with a light nasal sound, lips just touching.

ghunnah.name: Ghunnah (nasal sound)
ghunnah.what: A doubled nun or mim (نّ, مّ).
ghunnah.how: Hold a nasal sound for 2 counts, resonating through the nose.

iqlab.name: Iqlab (switching)
iqlab.what: A nun sakinah or tanwin before the letter ب.
iqlab.how: Change the nun into a hidden mim sound, with a nasal sound for about 2 counts.

idgham_ghunnah.name: Idgham with ghunnah (merging)
idgham_ghunnah.what: A nun sakinah or tanwin before ي ن م or و.
idgham_ghunnah.how: Merge the nun into the next letter with a nasal sound, as if it were doubled.

idgham_wo_ghunnah.name: Idgham without ghunnah
idgham_wo_ghunnah.what: A nun sakinah or tanwin before ل or ر.
idgham_wo_ghunnah.how: Merge the nun fully into the next letter, with no nasal sound.

idgham_shafawi.name: Idgham shafawi (lip merging)
idgham_shafawi.what: A mim sakinah before another mim.
idgham_shafawi.how: Merge the first mim into the second, with a nasal sound held for 2 counts.

idgham_mutajanisayn.name: Idgham mutajanisayn
idgham_mutajanisayn.what: Two letters from the same place in the mouth, the first with a sukun.
idgham_mutajanisayn.how: Merge the first letter into the second, saying it once with a shaddah.

idgham_mutaqaribayn.name: Idgham mutaqaribayn
idgham_mutaqaribayn.what: Two letters from nearby places in the mouth, the first with a sukun.
idgham_mutaqaribayn.how: Merge the first letter into the second, saying it once with a shaddah.
